candidates.name: Izborsk-Inčukalns Gas Pipeline
candidates.sponsor: Conexus Baltic Grid (Latvia/Estonia sections); Gazprom (Russian border side)

evidence.note: Conexus ELLI project page: Latvia receives Russian gas via Valdai-Pskov-Riga and Izborsk-Inčukalns UGS pipes; ELLI raised operating pressure of Izborsk-Inčukalns. Length unknown here (likely >25 km; Russian end only at Izborsk).

candidates.why_maybe_new: Roster has only P2447 Valdai-Pskov-Riga (Zimogor'e->Riga); this is a parallel, separate line terminating at Izborsk. Mostly outside Russia (Estonia/Latvia), so may belong to another country's scope; length unknown.

candidates.name: Izborsk-Värska-Tartu Gas Pipeline

evidence.note: ERR article on Värska area gas infrastructure near the Estonia-Latvia/Russia border; only weak, indirect support for the Izborsk-Värska-Tartu line; length unknown.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Not in roster; Russian end is only the Izborsk border point; weak evidence, consolidator decide; length unknown.
